summary: Lufax Holding filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement covering (1) renewal of continuing connected transactions and discloseable transactions with controlling shareholder Ping An Insurance, which indirectly holds approximately 66.85% of Lufax, and (2) the record date for an extraordinary general meeting. The board approved renewing five 2026 framework agreements for a two-year term from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2028, plus a new 2027 Account Management Framework Agreement with Ping An Property Casualty. An independent financial adviser was named. This is a routine related-party/EGM notice, not a special situation; watch only for EGM approval mechanics.
